current_milestone: M25 Voice - local Japanese TTS provider

last_verified.normal_state: Standalone crate crates/nagi-tts-provider (jpreprocess 0.15.0 + jbonsai 0.4.2, naist-jdic, HTS voice tohoku-f01 neutral) implements nagi_audio::speech::TextToSpeechProvider. Host evidence only (Linux aarch64 sandbox and Linux x86_64 GitHub-hosted runner): model-free tests, real-engine tests with pinned artifacts, and host measurements pass. Nagi target: no_std core check and engine-enabled check + release rlib build for x86_64-unknown-nagi-user via -Zbuild-std=std,panic_abort; nothing linked into nagi-init and nothing run in the guest. Guest playback through AudioServicePlaybackSink is NOT_RUN. Shared-file changes (registry, CI, models.lock, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES, implementation_status, nagi-init feature) are proposals only. Dedicated workstream CI (.github/workflows/hark-m25-local-tts.yml) runs the model-free checks, Nagi target builds and the real-engine acceptance on hark/m25-local-tts; it is not owner registration and not part of ci.yml. A truncated .htsvoice is rejected as VoiceInvalid before jbonsai parses it (it previously panicked inside jbonsai 0.4.2).

do_not_try: Do not report host synthesis or a target rlib as guest PASS.
Do not accept VOICEVOX or other voice terms on the user's behalf.
Do not edit shared files (nagi-init, root Cargo, models.lock, sources.lock, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES, implementation_status, ci.yml, registry, schema) from this stream.
Do not truncate over-cap audio and report success.
Do not count the dedicated workflow as owner registration or the no_std core check as engine target PASS.

next_action: Shared owner reviews integration-proposal.md (registry entry, models.lock, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES text, ci.yml step (the dedicated hark-m25-local-tts.yml workflow already runs on this branch), m25-tts-std nagi-init feature); then link the provider into nagi-init, load voice and dictionary through the Model Store as bytes, and run guest playback on QEMU measuring stack and memory.
acceptance_criteria: A local Japanese engine implements TextToSpeechProvider with bounded input, bounded whole-frame S16LE output (stereo 48 kHz or mono 16 kHz), fail-closed cap, cancel and failure cleanup.
Real-engine host tests pass with pinned, checksummed artifacts and fail when artifacts are missing.
Licenses and notices for engine, dictionary and voice are recorded with exact upstream copies.
The provider builds for the Nagi user target.
Real Japanese speech plays through AudioServicePlaybackSink in the Nagi guest (NOT_RUN).
deferred: Removing memmap2 via upstream lindera default-features=false.
A provider-level UtteranceTooLong distinct from ProviderFailed (nagi-audio contract decision).
